meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra, Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Zhu Xiao-Mei, Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang, Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
